name: My Fake Fiancé Is the War God
original_name: My Fake Fiancé Is the War God
overview: One night with the God of War leaves Serena pregnant with a forbidden child. To save the baby, she strikes a bargain with Fate and forgets the father completely. But when she enters his temple, Ares is drawn to her with an obsession he can’t explain. And he’s already willing to give up everything for her.
